programmes.programName: Doctoral Degree, School of Mechanical Engineering
programmes.department: Section of Industrial Management and Operational Research
programmes.evidence: NTUA current postgraduate page says each School offers an original-research Doctoral Degree with a defended thesis. A 2024 official School-hosted PhD thesis notice explicitly identifies doctoral work in the Section of Industrial Management and Operational Research. This is one general School research doctorate hosted at the named section, not a separately titled Operational Research degree.

researchDoctorateEvidence.evidence: The official university page expressly names its Doctoral Degree, requires original and significant research contribution, and describes a 3–6 year doctoral thesis defended before a seven-member faculty committee.

limitations: Exact Doctoral Degree credential retained; the official School notice uses PhD for a thesis but the central formal credential is Doctoral Degree.
No inference that the OM List individual's 2012 doctorate belonged to this section or current route.

branches.conclusion: NTUA central institutional/school inventory identifies technical Schools rather than a business school; no independent NTUA business doctoral branch asserted.

Central research-doctorate framework, current Mechanical School Operational Research Section and section-hosted PhD thesis verified. Other relevant engineering/mathematical named doctoral areas require bounded review.

sources.note: Original-research Doctoral Degree, doctoral thesis defence, all nine Schools.
Official PhD thesis notice with School and Section title, 2024; evidence of section doctoral host, not proof of individual imported degree.

limitations: One section-hosted general doctoral route verified; no extra degrees inferred from labs or MSc specializations.
